rules.statement: A plaintiff is barred from maintaining a fresh action for the same matter or in respect of the same part if they withdraw their suit against some defendants without obtaining permission.
rules.supporting_quote: Section 406 (2) of the Civil Procedure Code enacts that 'if the plaintiff withdraw from the action, or abandon part of his claim, without such permission (the permission of the Court referred to in sub-section (1)) .... he shall be precluded from bringing a fresh action for the same matter or in respect of the same part'.
